{{Quote|Well, well... Looks like the Republic sent someone in after all. You don't really think you can escape from here, do you?|Mord Jayran, to a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]]|<ref name="TCWA">{{TCWA|Skirmish on Carlac: Captive Village}}</ref>}}
'''Mord Jayran''' was a member of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] who served in a captive [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] [[City/Legends|village]] on [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] during the [[Skirmish on Carlac|skirmish]] there. He awaited the arrival of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] agent, a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]], whom he fought in the center of the village.
